item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 28/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, showers will increase and there will be thunderstorms over the coast of southern China today. The tropical cyclone to the east of Luzon Strait will linger over the region and intensify gradually in the next couple of days. It will then move towards the vicinity of Taiwan to the East China Sea. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be very hot over southern China early next week. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Tuesday. The weather will be slightly cooler and dry over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
